claim: Separate the value of the head-distribution summary from the effect of stopping its gradient before the tail selector

intervention.detached_summary: The tail selector reads entropy, expected edge length, and maximum head probability, but its gradient does not flow through these statistics into the head scorer
intervention.end_to_end_summary: The same statistics and forward computation are retained, but their gradient is allowed to flow into the head scorer
intervention.no_summary: The three statistics and their projection are removed from tail scoring
